_about: Tier 1 objectives and difficulty modes. Compiled with help from Claude (AI).

objectives.name: Watch hurricanes form
objectives.summary: Measure temperature and rain inside tropical storms several times a day.

requirements.text: Carry an instrument that can see inside storms
Return at least 0.25 GB of science data per day
Stay under the cost cap with 10% in reserve

real_missions.name: TROPICS
real_missions.note: A NASA constellation of 3U CubeSats with microwave radiometers that watch tropical cyclones.

sources.real_missions: NASA mission page (to verify before release)

objectives.name: Monitor crops and wildfires
objectives.summary: Photograph farmland and forests in several colours to track plant health and burn scars.

requirements.text: Carry a camera that sees several colour bands
Hold the camera steady on its target
Return at least 0.9 GB of images per day
Stay under the cost cap with 10% in reserve

real_missions.name: Landsat
real_missions.note: The long-running NASA and USGS programme that images all of Earth's land. Far larger than a CubeSat, same idea.

sources.real_missions: NASA mission page (to verify before release)

objectives.name: Measure space weather
objectives.summary: Record changes in Earth's magnetic field as solar storms arrive.

requirements.text: Carry a magnetic field sensor held away from the electronics
Return at least 0.004 GB of measurements per day
Stay under the cost cap with 10% in reserve

difficulties.name: Office Hours
difficulties.rules: Sandbox. No cost cap and the review is optional.
difficulties.source: NASA: Mission Design Lab (tier names); rules are Game balance

difficulties.name: Concept Development
difficulties.rules: Margins relaxed to 20% and a generous budget.
difficulties.source: NASA: Mission Design Lab (tier names); rules are Game balance

difficulties.name: Trade Study
difficulties.rules: Full NASA margins. Compare two saved designs to reach CML 3.
difficulties.source: NASA: Mission Design Lab (tier names); rules are Game balance

difficulties.name: Point Design
difficulties.rules: Full rules, a tighter budget and two in-flight events.
difficulties.source: NASA: Mission Design Lab (tier names); rules are Game balance
